name: bipartite_check
author: 62a230f4
description: Checks whether the graph is bipartite: nodes split into two sides with every edge going between sides. Use for questions about two-group structure, such as students vs projects. Directed graphs are treated as undirected. If it is bipartite, returns both sides (counts plus up to top_k nodes each) and registers the larger side as result_graph_id. If not, explains why.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse.

top_k.description: How many nodes to list from each side.
